## Football effect

Posluszny played all 64 defensive snaps with seven tackles, five solo, and a pressure; after the injury was logged he sacked Rivers for 4 on third-and-1 in the third quarter over Rinehart's slot, which forced a punt, and made the tackle on Woodhead's 11-yard run on San Diego's last possession. On the projection he misses the Wednesday and Thursday practices of the Pittsburgh week and returns on Friday, October 3; his availability follows the medical staff's communication, not the projection. Daryl Smith is the other base linebacker; Stanford, Moore and Telvin Smith are next on the chart. No role change follows and no football finding attaches to the instruction.
